# routeros_tool_graphing_settings (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_tool_graphing_settings" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `page_refresh` (String) How often to refresh HTML pages (in seconds). Possible values: `never`.
- `store_every` (String) How often to store information on system drive. Possible values: `24hours`, `5min`, `hour`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_tool_graphing_settings.settings .
```
